name: python-dragonquest
description: 勇者斗恶龙 - 游戏化Python编程教学网站

scripts.service:start: npm run service:dev >/dev/null && nohup npm run dev -- --port 11001 > /tmp/frontend.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $! > /tmp/frontend.pid
scripts.service:stop: if [ -f /tmp/frontend.pid ]; then PID=$(cat /tmp/frontend.pid); if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM "$PID"; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; else rm -f /tmp/frontend.pid; fi; else echo "frontend.pid not found"; fi; if [ -f /tmp/execution-service.pid ]; then PID=$(cat /tmp/execution-service.pid); if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM "$PID"; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; else rm -f /tmp/execution-service.pid; fi; else echo "execution-service.pid not found"; fi
scripts.service:restart: npm run service:stop && npm run service:start
scripts.frontend:stop: if [ -f /tmp/frontend.pid ]; then PID=$(cat /tmp/frontend.pid); if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM "$PID"; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; else rm -f /tmp/frontend.pid; fi; else echo "frontend.pid not found"; fi
scripts.execution:stop: if [ -f /tmp/execution-service.pid ]; then PID=$(cat /tmp/execution-service.pid); if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM "$PID"; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; else rm -f /tmp/execution-service.pid; fi; else echo "execution-service.pid not found"; fi
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
